answer.explanation: Resident3 contributed >30 in the last round, so punish with maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/0.3)=33). Also broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 9.91 < threshold 10, so cannot contribute minimum 1. So rule: if wallet above threshold, contribute 1 else rest. Also check if any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round (round 4). In round 4 contributions_by_agent: Resident3 contributed 38.52 (>30). So punish that resident with max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost) = floor(9.91/0.3)= floor(33.033)=33. So can punish Resident3 severity 33 costing 33*0.3=9.9, within wallet 9.91. So we should punish Resident3 amount 33. Also broadcast discouraging message. We can do both physical and communication. So actions: punish Resident3 amount 33, broadcast message. Explanation.
